{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders
refunded_mask = df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
df_clean = df_clean[~refunded_mask].copy()

# Filter for converted orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1].copy()

# Check final dataset
print(f"Final dataset shape: {df_final.shape}")
print(f"Channel distribution: {df_final['channel'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Average revenue per converted order by channel:\n{avg_revenue_by_channel}")

# Compute the difference
diff = avg_revenue_by_channel['email'] - avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.2f}")"}
